content: Gollwitzer & Sheeran 2006 meta-analysis (94 studies, 8000+ participants): implementation intentions (if-then plans) produce medium-large effect on goal attainment, d=0.65. A 2024 meta-analysis (642 tests) found effects across cognitive/affective/behavioural outcomes ranging .27<=d<=.66. Effects are larger when the plan is contingent (if-then format), the person is motivated, and the plan is rehearsed at least once. This is one of the more robust, non-shrinking effects in social psychology.
